notes: Single source of truth for injected anomalies. Read by shared/anomalies.ts (simulator) and ml/src/inject.py (offline evaluation). Magnitudes are simulation parameters, not clinical thresholds; they are calibrated in phase 6.

activity_drop.label: Reducción de actividad
activity_drop.rule: Per block and channel: x' = mean + (1 - m) * (x - mean). Movement amplitude drops by m.

immobility.label: Inmovilidad prolongada
immobility.rule: Same transform as activity_drop with m close to 1: only the posture (block mean) remains.

tachycardia.label: Taquicardia sostenida
tachycardia.rule: hr' = hr * (1 + m * ramp). Relative to the dog's own rate.

bradycardia.label: Bradicardia sostenida
bradycardia.rule: hr' = hr * (1 - m * ramp). Relative to the dog's own rate.

collar_off.label: Collar quitado o sin señal
collar_off.rule: Not an anomaly of the dog: each IMU channel stays at its block mean (no movement at all), the heart rate is lost and the temperature reads the ambient value m (°C), outside the prefilter. The system must say «Revisa el collar» and open no alert.
